conditions.trials: Each fresh restart30s warmup+120s completed rendering including normal draftwalltime
conditions.background: Otherdesktopappsopen; normal production preparation mayrun concurrently; foreground stalls retained; no isolated-machineclaim

scheduledStart.semantics: Warm-up arms at the first completed active render reaching the requested earned gameplay time. Its preceding foreground interval is retained whole, including threshold-crossing stalls. Earlier lifecycle and simulation-clock failures remain invalidating.
scheduledStart.highWaterScope: Population high-water marks cover the whole attempt, including pre-arm play. Use the gameplay-time resourceSamples for the late population timeline.
